content:
Priya: opened PR to add a compact runbook for Private/VPC egress + KMS/HSM sanity checks: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2799
Ethan: Nice. Can we include a tiny nftables sample, a systemd override, and offline verify commands? Keeps support calls down.
Priya: Drafting now. Will avoid any real ARNs/slot IDs and standardize headings to HSM.
Luis: nftables (ubuntu22 minimal):
```
add table inet rw_egress
add chain inet rw_egress input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
add rule inet rw_egress input ct state established,related accept
add rule inet rw_egress input ip saddr 10.200.0.0/24 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Ethan: systemd hint:
```
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/proxy.env
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=7
LimitNOFILE=65536
```
Priya: offline verify: `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256`. Add note about importing offline pubkey first.
Maya: editorial: use "Transit Gateway" consistently and prefer "egress proxy" in headings. Also add a 3-step troubleshooting checklist: tcpdump, nftables rules, systemd status.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck warning -> docs/private/egress.md '#sni-preserve' missing (job #842)
Priya: Added anchor and short paragraph about SNI preservation vs TLS passthrough. Pushed commit.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed. Ready to merge.
Ethan: Can you backport a one-line snippet to release/1.2 for customers on older installers?
Priya: Will do and include changelog line. Thanks all.
DocsBot: PR merged and backported to release/1.2.x. Thread closed.
